topics.topic: A day on Venus is longer than its year; Venus spins backwards
Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the Great Pyramid
The Zeigarnik effect: unfinished tasks are remembered better
Orionid meteor shower is dust from Halley's Comet (peaks Oct 21-22, ~66 km/s)
Octopuses have three hearts and blue copper-based blood; systemic heart stops when swimming
Astronauts grow up to 3% taller in space
First parachute jump: Garnerin, Paris, Oct 22 1797 (silk parachute from balloon)
Vampire bats regurgitate/share blood meals with hungry roostmates, incl. non-kin
Bananas are slightly radioactive (potassium-40, banana equivalent dose)
Mole Day (Oct 23, 6:02-6:02) and Avogadro's number 6.02x10^23; a mole of water is ~18 g
First jack-o'-lanterns were carved from turnips (Ireland/Scotland) and beets (England); pumpkins in America
Sugar-cube of neutron star weighs ~1 billion tons; ~20 km wide; spin hundreds of times/sec
First person over Niagara Falls in a barrel: Annie Edson Taylor, Oct 24 1901, her 63rd birthday (cat tested barrel first)
Owls can't move their tubular eyes; rotate heads ~270 degrees; 14 neck vertebrae vs 7 in humans
Clocks go back Oct 25 2026 in Europe (US Nov 1); Germany first nationwide DST in 1916 to save fuel in WWI; Franklin's 1784 joke essay
Statue of Liberty was originally shiny copper; unveiled Oct 28 1886; copper ~2 pennies thick; green patina from ~1903, fully green ~1920; 1906 paint plan dropped; patina protects
Félicette, first cat in space: Oct 18 1963, French Véronique rocket from Algeria, >150 km, ~5 min weightless, 13 min flight, recovered; statue 2019
Pumpkins are botanical berries (pepo) like watermelons/cucumbers; bananas, tomatoes are berries; strawberries/raspberries are not
Smallpox: only human disease eradicated; last natural case Ali Maow Maalin, Merca Somalia, rash Oct 26 1977; WHO certified eradication Oct 26 1979; he later volunteered for polio
Crows remember human faces (UW Seattle caveman-mask study, Marzluff); untrapped and young crows learned to scold; 20%->60% at one site after 5 years
Mars sunsets are blue (dust forward-scatters blue light); photographed by Curiosity/Opportunity; daytime sky butterscotch
NYC subway opened Oct 27 1904 (IRT, 9.1 mi, 28 stations, nickel fare); Mayor McClellan drove first train to 103rd St; 100k+ riders first evening
Wood frogs freeze solid in winter: up to 60% of body ice, heart/breathing stop, up to 7 months in Alaska, glucose antifreeze
Goosebumps: arrector pili muscles raise hairs; fur insulation/look bigger in animals; sympathetic (fight-or-flight) so emotions trigger it; likely evolutionary leftover in humans
First ARPANET message Oct 29 1969: UCLA (Charley Kline) to SRI, 'LOGIN' crashed after 'LO'; full login ~1 hour later
War of the Worlds radio broadcast Oct 30 1938 (Orson Welles): mass panic largely a newspaper myth; Hooper survey ~2% listening; most on Chase and Sanborn Hour
Skull-shaped asteroid 2015 TB145 flew by Oct 31 2015 at ~1.3 lunar distances, ~600 m wide, likely dead comet (Arecibo radar)

Houdini died Halloween Oct 31 1926 in Detroit (100th anniversary 2026); secret code 'Rosabelle... believe' with wife Bess; she held Halloween séances 10 years, last 1936 Knickerbocker Hotel rooftop; tradition continues
Mantis shrimp punch ~50 mph, <3 ms, up to 10,000 g; cavitation bubbles boil water, second impact, flashes of light; broke 1/4-inch aquarium glass (1998)
Saturn is the only planet less dense than water (~0.69 g/cm3); NASA 'float in a bathtub' joke; ~9x Earth's width; would fall apart (no solid surface)
